Marty, you're carrying a lot right now — 5 time-critical deals plus 20 orphan accounts to clean, with Silis and Ontomedia (both GTX Plus Pro, $5,472 each) sitting at the top. Block 2 hours Tuesday morning to batch-call Silis and Ontomedia back-to-back while they're still warm. Lean into your telecom edge — you're +29pp over the team there, so push the deals that play to it. You're not alone on this: I'll personally work the orphan cleanup with you so it doesn't eat your selling time. Let's close.

Melvin
